ConsequenceModel.description:
In CWE parlance, a consequence entails a scope (from the CIA triad),
a technical explanation of the impact, and optional notes.

impact.description: A technical description of the impact enabled by this weakness
impact.title: Impact

note.description: An optional note about the impact
note.title: Note

PlatformInfoModel.description:
Platform information is derived from the weakness itself.
The CWE documentation often leaves these fields empty or even ambiguous.
An LLM classification step may be desirable to enrich or supplement these
shortcomings.

langauges.description: A list of related programming languages
langauges.title: Langauges

is_language_specific.description: A heuristic from the platform info.
is_language_specific.title: Is Language Specific

operating_systems.description: A list of related operating systems
operating_systems.title: Operating Systems

is_os_specific.description: A heuristic from the platform info.
is_os_specific.title: Is Os Specific

is_technology_specific.description: A heuristic from the platform info.
is_technology_specific.title: Is Technology Specific

is_architecture_specific.description: A heuristic from the platform info
is_architecture_specific.title: Is Architecture Specific

description:
This schema captures key information about a CWE.
It does not capture ALL information, including references and mapping notes.
For complex analysis, refer to the official documentation.

mapping.description: Whether the CWE can be mapped to real-world vulnerabilities
mapping.title: Mapping

abstraction.description: The CWE's abstraction level (base and variant preferred)
abstraction.title: Abstraction

extended_description.description: An optional extended description of the weakness
extended_description.title: Extended Description

cves.description: A list of known CVE vulnerabilities whose root cause is represented by this weakness
cves.title: Cves

capecs.description: A list of CAPEC attack patterns associated with this weakness
capecs.title: Capecs

platform_info.description: Any platform information associated with the weakness

consequences.description: Any impacts associated with this weakness
consequences.title: Consequences
